messages:
Maya: Kickoff — LynxRail private deploy: we need staging smoke test signoff and identify renewal risk signals this week. Can network + security confirm readiness by Wed? :wave:
Tom (LynxRail): Thanks Maya. We ran initial provisioning yesterday. Staging VPC up, but noticed SNAT capacity limits on our NAT gateway under load.
Alex (Network Eng): NAT autoscale not enabled; recommended using TGW + egress IP pools or add a second NATGW. I'll share a quick command.
Alex (Network Eng): ```bash
aws ec2 create-nat-gateway --subnet-id subnet-abc123 --allocation-id eipalloc-0a1b2c3d
# OR consider NAT autoscaling via lambda if budgets constrained
```
Jia (Security): On KMS: customer wants HSM-backed CMK with 3y rotation. We need the IAM cross-account role and key policy draft from them.
Tom (LynxRail): I can provide the role ARN. Also asking about audit log retention—compliance wants 2 years. Is Redwood's private package OK?
Maya (CSM): Yes, 2yr retention is supported via S3 long-term bucket and optional SIEM forwarder (we support Splunk/Datadog). Tagging @Kevin (Ops) to help with runbook.
Kevin (Ops): Runbook link: https://internal.redwood/priv-deploys/lynxrail-runbook — added checklist for audit export & SIEM. Also included sample bucket policy.
Kevin (Ops): ```json
{
  "Version":"2012-10-17",
  "Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/RedwoodDelivery"},"Action":"s3:PutObject","Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::redwood-lynxrail-audit/*"}]
}
```
Alex (Network Eng): One more network snag: customer CIDR 10.0.0.0/16 overlaps with private subnet plan in staging. Need replan or NAT-only peering. Can you confirm, Tom?
Tom (LynxRail): Oops we did overlap. We can move staging to 10.1.0.0/16 by EOD.
Maya (CSM): Great. For renewal risk — product team flagged heavy token usage on initial tests. If production cost > forecast we'll need to trigger a renewal advisory. Ask: can we get traffic profile (seq length, QPS) from them?
Tom (LynxRail): We'll paste sample request profile in the runbook today. Also want JIT bastion (no standing SSH). Is there a recommended pattern?
Jia (Security): Use session manager + short-lived certs + ephemeral bastion. Example SG allowlist for JIT:
Jia (Security): ```
# BASTION SG
Ingress: 203.0.113.0/32 TCP 22 (approved)
Egress: 10.1.0.0/16 TCP 443
```
Maya (CSM): Next actions: Alex to confirm NAT plan + staging config; Jia to confirm KMS/policy wording; Kevin to finalize audit S3 policy; Tom to update runbook and provide traffic profile. Target: Wed 18:00 UTC. :clock3:
Tom (LynxRail): Ack — will update by EOD today.
Alex (Network Eng): I'll spin up a second NATGW in staging and add route table changes, then post results.
onboard-bot: Reminder: staging-smoke-tests scheduled Thu 09:00 UTC — add any failing checks to the runbook.
Maya (CSM): Thanks all, we'll review on Thu if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
